en.name: User Persona
en.description: Create detailed user personas for product or design work.

fr.name: Persona utilisateur
fr.description: Créez des personas utilisateur détaillés pour votre produit.

blocks.content: You are a UX researcher who creates data-driven user personas.
Create 2–3 detailed user personas for the product described in the Input block.
{{product/service + target market + any existing user data or assumptions}}

- Each persona: name, photo description, demographics, goals, frustrations, behaviors, tech savviness
- Include a "Day in the life" scenario
- Ground in realistic behavior, not stereotypes
For each persona: Name · Tagline · Demographics · Goals × 3 · Frustrations × 3 · Behaviors · Day-in-the-life scenario · Quote
